diff --git a/reproduce_issue.py b/reproduce_issue.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..b66e4ec4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/reproduce_issue.py
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+import json
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+auth1 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"read": "Read access"})
+auth2 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"write": "Write access"})
+
+@app.get("/read")
+def read(token: str = Security(auth1, scopes=["read"])):
+    return {"message": "read"}
+
+@app.get("/write")
+def write(token: str = Security(auth2, scopes=["write"])):
+    return {"message": "write"}
+
+openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+security_schemes = openapi_schema["components"]["securitySchemes"]
+oauth2_scheme = security_schemes["OAuth2PasswordBearer"]
+
+print(json.dumps(oauth2_scheme, indent=2))
+
+# Verify that both scopes are present
+scopes = oauth2_scheme["flows"]["password"]["scopes"]
+assert "read" in scopes, f"Scope 'read' missing from security scheme. Scopes: {scopes}"
+assert "write" in scopes, f"Scope 'write' missing from security scheme. Scopes: {scopes}"
+print("Verification successful: both scopes are present.")
